name: Colchester Parks & Recreation Programs (Summer)
description_short: Colchester, VT Parks & Recreation runs programs for all ages, including summer camps from June to August. This page covers how to register, pay, and get refunds. It does not list individual camps.
refund_policy_summary: Camp refunds: until May 31, 100% back minus a $25 admin fee. From June 1 until 14 days before camp starts, 75% back minus a $25 admin fee. The same rules apply to transfers. Requests must be in writing to recreation@colchestervt.gov. If a program is cancelled for low enrollment, you get a full refund. Card and online payments carry a 3% service fee, and online registrations must be paid in full.
special_needs_notes: Children with special needs are encouraged to take part. Most parks and facilities comply with the ADA. Call the Recreation Department to ask about access or program details.

warnings: This is the town's general registration-policy page, not a listing for one camp. Camp details are in the linked 2026 Summer Brochure and the rec1 catalog.
Only the 2026 season is shown, and it is already over (today is 2026-10-13). 2027 details are not posted yet.
The 2026 registration dates were: residents from Monday, January 26 at 8:00 am; non-residents from February 9. The 2027 dates may be different.
The address in the footer (781 Blakely Road) is the Town of Colchester office, not necessarily where the camp is held, so it was not recorded.
